stories.headline: Dolly Parton dies at 80
stories.body: Singer-songwriter, actor and literacy advocate Dolly Parton died at 80 after a career spanning more than six decades.

stories.headline: Judge blocks Ohio citizenship-proof rule for motor-voter registration
stories.body: The order keeps documentary citizenship proof from being required for people registering to vote through Ohio motor vehicle offices.

stories.headline: Projectile disables oil tanker near Strait of Hormuz
stories.body: An unidentified projectile disabled an oil tanker off Oman near the largely closed waterway; its crew was safe.

stories.headline: Study finds CTE in at least 24.5% of deceased NFL players
stories.body: Researchers confirmed CTE in at least 24.5% of 878 former NFL players who died from 2016 through 2021, despite most lacking postmortem exams.

sources.name: Boston University Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine
